texture_repaint.method: three zone kinds per part (textures.py repaint): phantom_zone (12 mm of a phantom vertex), phantom_miss (8-connected ray-miss clusters within 20 mm of a phantom vertex: the filled holes and the smoothed strip, weight 1 + 3 mm ring) and the manual box (cloak strip, x -0.108..-0.045, z 0.27..0.53 Tripo frame). Donor = nearest clean texel at the mirrored point; the cloak uses red-cloth donors only (mirror_cloth) in a metric with Y weighted 0.15 for back-facing targets (plain 3D for side-facing fold walls), a facing check (k = 8), and a 3 mm-step x shift (<= 24 mm) off the mirrored border band; hit texels of large gold components (border band) inside the zones keep the Tripo paint. Normals: the donor tangent normal is moved as detail relief (donor frame -> object -> mirror -> minimal rotation onto the target normal -> target frame); disagreeing normals stay flat

lowpoly.method: per part: Blender Decimate COLLAPSE (quadric, triangulated, no symmetry) on the welded untextured high-poly to target_tris; cleanup: weld 1e-6 m, dissolve degenerate, delete loose, triangulate; smooth shading, hard edges only on UV seams with a dihedral angle above uv.sharp_angle_deg

uv.method: charts per part (charts.py: normal-cone region growing over the face adjacency, folds > 120 deg always cut, small charts merged, SLIM MINIMUM_STRETCH unwrap with no_flip, islands that flip or compress below bad_area_ratio re-segmented with a narrower cone); every island scaled to a uniform texel density (sqrt(3D area / UV area)) times the part's texel_priority (bottom faces of the base: bottom_faces_priority), then one pack of all parts (rotate ANY, CONCAVE, margin fraction) into 0..1. Smart UV Project was measured first and rejected: 6019 islands, 4.8 % coverage

gap_check.note: gap = distance between the nearest texel centres of two islands, measured on the 4K raster (a triangle edge touching a texel centre counts as covered)

normal_map_probe.note: difference of the baked tangent normal with the Tripo normal map linked vs unlinked on the high material: > 0 means the detail normal map is carried into the bake

phantom_misses_repainted.rule: 8-connected miss clusters of the repaint parts within 20 mm of a phantom vertex, weight 1

other_misses.rule: nearest valid texel of the same UV island (EDT restricted to the island); islands without a hit: nearest valid texel of the same part in 3D (POS)
